## 10. Out-of-fold ranking and top-20% selection

Each individual has five held-out predictions for every trait and ANN variant.
The five predictions are averaged before the global ordering is constructed.

The upper 20% contains exactly 39 of the 195 individuals. When observed or
predicted BLUPs are tied at the selection boundary, `ID` is used only as a
deterministic secondary ordering criterion.

```{r individual-ranking, eval=FINAL_OUTPUTS_AVAILABLE}
TOP20_N <- 39L

individual_ranking <- data.frame(
  Model = character(0),
  Trait = character(0),
  ID = character(0),
  Observed_BLUP = numeric(0),
  Predicted_BLUP = numeric(0),
  Prediction_SD = numeric(0),
  N_OOF = integer(0),
  Observed_Rank = numeric(0),
  Predicted_Rank = numeric(0),
  Rank_Difference = numeric(0),
  Absolute_Rank_Error = numeric(0),
  Observed_Top20 = logical(0),
  Predicted_Top20 = logical(0),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

ranking_summary <- data.frame(
  Model = character(0),
  Trait = character(0),
  Individuals = integer(0),
  Ranking_Spearman = numeric(0),
  Mean_Absolute_Rank_Error = numeric(0),
  Median_Absolute_Rank_Error = numeric(0),
  Top20_N = integer(0),
  Top20_Overlap_N = integer(0),
  Top20_Overlap_Rate = numeric(0),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (
  model_name in
    MODEL_LEVELS
) {

  for (
    trait in
      traits
  ) {

    x <- predictions[
      predictions$Model ==
        model_name &
        predictions$Trait ==
        trait,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    ranking_group <- data.frame(
      Model = character(0),
      Trait = character(0),
      ID = character(0),
      Observed_BLUP = numeric(0),
      Predicted_BLUP = numeric(0),
      Prediction_SD = numeric(0),
      N_OOF = integer(0),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    for (
      individual_id in
        ids
    ) {

      xi <- x[
        x$ID ==
          individual_id,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]

      stopifnot(
        nrow(
          xi
        ) == 5L,
        length(
          unique(
            xi$Observed_BLUP
          )
        ) == 1L
      )

      ranking_group <- rbind(
        ranking_group,
        data.frame(
          Model =
            model_name,
          Trait =
            trait,
          ID =
            individual_id,
          Observed_BLUP =
            unique(
              xi$Observed_BLUP
            ),
          Predicted_BLUP =
            mean(
              xi$Predicted_BLUP
            ),
          Prediction_SD =
            sd(
              xi$Predicted_BLUP
            ),
          N_OOF =
            nrow(
              xi
            ),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      )
    }

    ranking_group$Observed_Rank <- rank(
      -ranking_group$Observed_BLUP,
      ties.method = "average"
    )

    ranking_group$Predicted_Rank <- rank(
      -ranking_group$Predicted_BLUP,
      ties.method = "average"
    )

    ranking_group$Rank_Difference <-
      ranking_group$Predicted_Rank -
      ranking_group$Observed_Rank

    ranking_group$Absolute_Rank_Error <-
      abs(
        ranking_group$Rank_Difference
      )

    observed_order <- order(
      -ranking_group$Observed_BLUP,
      ranking_group$ID
    )

    predicted_order <- order(
      -ranking_group$Predicted_BLUP,
      ranking_group$ID
    )

    ranking_group$Observed_Top20 <- FALSE
    ranking_group$Predicted_Top20 <- FALSE

    ranking_group$Observed_Top20[
      observed_order[
        seq_len(
          TOP20_N
        )
      ]
    ] <- TRUE

    ranking_group$Predicted_Top20[
      predicted_order[
        seq_len(
          TOP20_N
        )
      ]
    ] <- TRUE

    top20_overlap_n <- sum(
      ranking_group$Observed_Top20 &
        ranking_group$Predicted_Top20
    )

    top20_overlap_rate <-
      top20_overlap_n /
      TOP20_N

    individual_ranking <- rbind(
      individual_ranking,
      ranking_group
    )

    ranking_summary <- rbind(
      ranking_summary,
      data.frame(
        Model =
          model_name,
        Trait =
          trait,
        Individuals =
          nrow(
            ranking_group
          ),
        Ranking_Spearman =
          cor(
            ranking_group$Observed_Rank,
            ranking_group$Predicted_Rank,
            method = "spearman"
          ),
        Mean_Absolute_Rank_Error =
          mean(
            ranking_group$Absolute_Rank_Error
          ),
        Median_Absolute_Rank_Error =
          median(
            ranking_group$Absolute_Rank_Error
          ),
        Top20_N =
          TOP20_N,
        Top20_Overlap_N =
          top20_overlap_n,
        Top20_Overlap_Rate =
          top20_overlap_rate,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
}

rownames(
  individual_ranking
) <- NULL

rownames(
  ranking_summary
) <- NULL

stopifnot(
  nrow(
    individual_ranking
  ) == 2340L,
  nrow(
    ranking_summary
  ) == 12L,
  all(
    individual_ranking$N_OOF ==
      5L
  ),
  sum(
    individual_ranking$Observed_Top20
  ) == 468L,
  sum(
    individual_ranking$Predicted_Top20
  ) == 468L,
  all(
    ranking_summary$Top20_N ==
      39L
  )
)

saveRDS(
  individual_ranking,
  FINAL_RANKING_RDS,
  compress = "gzip"
)

write.csv(
  individual_ranking,
  FINAL_RANKING_CSV,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  ranking_summary,
  FINAL_RANKING_SUMMARY_CSV,
  row.names = FALSE
)

ranking_summary |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    digits = 4,
    caption = "Agreement between observed and out-of-fold predicted rankings",
    row.names = FALSE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-hover table-bordered" style="width:100%;"'
  )
```

## 11. Predictive figures

```{r performance-figures, eval=FINAL_OUTPUTS_AVAILABLE}
plot_results <- results

plot_results$Model <- factor(
  plot_results$Model,
  levels =
    MODEL_LEVELS
)

plot_results$Trait <- factor(
  plot_results$Trait,
  levels =
    traits
)

p_pearson <- ggplot(
  plot_results[
    is.finite(
      plot_results$BLUP_Correlation
    ),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ],
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = BLUP_Correlation
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.12,
    height = 0,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.60
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Trait,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "ANN variant",
    y = "Pearson correlation",

  ) +
  ggthemes::theme_gdocs() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 35,
      hjust = 1
```
